description: This file contains numerous functions related to system configuration, environment checks, security assessments, and setup validation for the TestLink open source testing management platform. It includes functions for URL detection, environment validation, PHP extension checks, database schema validation, and security warning generation.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing a user in the system, with methods to read user data from database and compare passwords.

methods.name: get_home_url
methods.description: Determines the base URL of the application, considering server variables and HTTPS configuration.

methods.name: checkServerLanguageSettings
methods.description: Checks the client's accepted language settings against available locales.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies if the system configuration file exists; redirects to installer if missing.

methods.name: checkInstallStatus
methods.description: Detects whether the application has been installed by checking the definition of DB_TYPE.

methods.name: checkLibGd
methods.description: Checks if GD library with PNG support is available.

methods.name: checkForExtensions
methods.description: Verifies that necessary PHP extensions are loaded.

methods.name: checkForInstallDir
methods.description: Checks if the install directory exists to ensure security.

methods.name: checkForAdminDefaultPwd
methods.description: Detects if the admin user still uses the default password.

methods.name: checkForLDAPExtension
methods.description: Checks if LDAP PHP extension is loaded.

methods.name: getSecurityNotes
methods.description: Gathers security-related issues found during system checks.

methods.name: checkForBTSConnection
methods.description: Checks connectivity to the bug tracking system database.

methods.name: isMSWindowsServer
methods.description: Determines if the server OS is a Windows flavor.

methods.name: checkForRepositoryDir
methods.description: Verifies if a given directory for repositories exists and is writable.

methods.name: checkSchemaVersion
methods.description: Validates the database schema version to ensure compatibility.

methods.name: checkEmailConfig
methods.description: Checks email-related configuration settings.

methods.name: check_php_settings
methods.description: Checks PHP runtime settings like max execution time, memory limit, and register_globals.

methods.name: checkPhpExtensions
methods.description: Validates availability of critical PHP extensions such as pgsql, mysqli, gd, ldap, json, curl.

methods.name: check_session
methods.description: Verifies if PHP sessions are properly configured.

methods.name: check_timeout
methods.description: Checks session timeout duration.

methods.name: checkDbType
methods.description: Validates the configured database type.

methods.name: checkServerOs
methods.description: Outputs server OS information.

methods.name: checkPhpVersion
methods.description: Compares current PHP version with minimum required version.

methods.name: check_file_permissions
methods.description: Verifies read/write permissions for a specific file depending on install stage.

methods.name: check_dir_permissions
methods.description: Checks existence and write permissions of critical directories.

methods.name: reportCheckingBrowser
methods.description: Generates HTML report to verify browser compatibility and JS support.

methods.name: reportCheckingSystem
methods.description: Displays system environment and PHP configuration checks.

methods.name: reportCheckingDatabase
methods.description: Outputs database support and configuration verification results.

methods.name: reportCheckingWeb
methods.description: Displays web server and PHP environment validation.

methods.name: reportCheckingPermissions
methods.description: Displays permission checks for files and directories.
